models_evaluated: FDA-cleared adult-trained AI algorithm for intracranial hemorrhage detection

links.outcome: Adult-trained AI performance when applied to pediatric patients aged 6-17 (off-population use)
links.effect: Sensitivity 94.2% (95% CI 89.6-97.2), specificity 94.7%, accuracy 94.6%, NPV 99.4%, PPV 62.5%; comparable to adult performance, though prospective validation is required.
links.quote: An adult-trained AI algorithm demonstrated high sensitivity, specificity, and accuracy for ICH detection in pediatric patients aged 6–17 years, comparable to its adult performance.

links.outcome: Performance of AI on local retrospective data against adjudicated reference standard
links.effect: Sensitivity 94.2%, specificity 94.7%, accuracy 94.6%, PPV 62.5%, NPV 99.4% in 1,996 pediatric NCHCTs across 21 sites.
links.quote: Compared with ground truth, AI achieved 94.2% sensitivity (95% CI, 89.6–97.2%), 94.7% specificity (95% CI, 93.6–95.7%), 94.6% accuracy (95% CI, 93.6–95.6%), 62.5% PPV (95% CI, 57.8–67.0%), and 99.4% NPV (95% CI, 99.0–99.7%).

links.outcome: Reliability of blinded three-radiologist adjudication of discordant cases for ground truth
links.effect: Interrater agreement for ground truth adjudication was substantial (kappa = 0.683).
links.quote: Interrater agreement for ground truth adjudication was substantial (κ = 0.683).

unlisted_practices: Off-label repurposing of adult-trained imaging AI for pediatric populations
Using NLP classification of radiology reports plus adjudication of discordant cases to build ground truth

screen.reason: Retrospective multi-institutional validation of an adult-trained commercial ICH detection AI on an off-label pediatric cohort (evaluates model performance/transferability, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard/practice).
